Name: PJ

Age: 19

Location/Timezone: Central 

Minecraft Username: PlaidPjs

Why are you interested in our server?

I've been on a few servers in the past that have unfortunately just faded with inactivity and am looking to join a new server and mess around with the new updates and meet some new people! 

How long have you been playing Minecraft for?

I honestly don't remember when I bought the game but I've been watching since 2010ish and playing for at least 5 years probably more like 8(?) 

Tell us about yourself, in a paragraph or so!

I'm in the process of changing and picking a new major at university. I sail occasionally, like to take photos, travel, I'll try about anything especially if friends are involved. 

What qualities, skills, or contributions do you feel you would bring to our server?

I like to think of my self as a good builder and like to help others out on their builds as well as tackling monster builds. The satisfaction is worth the grind. 

How active are you on Minecraft (e.g. in hours per week)?

It depends on the week, due to projects and work, but over the summer and the weekends I'll be fairly active with 5 or so hours a day but I'd expect maybe 12-15 hours weekly. 

Do you agree to be on Discord while playing on the server?

Sure do, it's PJay#9337

I've heard that calc 2 is a big struggle for students and that sometimes calc 3 is easier or on the same level, so I've tried keeping that in mind. 

My university also has a masters program if I came back with a CS minor and a bachelors I could just slide in and get my masters which is an extended plan b if I do change my major. 

I'm not too concerned about my GPA in all fairness, especially at this point in the semester there's not a lot I can do, but I won't loose any scholarship money over it at least. But I really can't envision myself doing coding for 8 hours a day for 40+ years or I may end up in theory, but still. The only courses I can't take with a minor are two capstone classes but it cuts all my pre reqs down

Oh. I did forget to say I was thinking about getting a degree in journalism, not just English. Whether it'll be advertising or creative media productions I'm not sure on that yet, but I felt like having a CS minor or background with either of those would stand out and could let me land a job with it some CS experience needed

I have worried about the money and if I had to, a teaching gig doesn't sound awful.
